finding: The original memory sampler selected executable names beginning with ollama once per request. The recorded names contain only ollama app.exe and ollama.exe. The installed native runner is named llama-server.exe, so the original values do not cover the complete inference process tree. Do not interpret those values as total Ollama inference RAM.
correction: The sampler now rediscovers Ollama roots and all recursive descendants on every sample, including native runners with different names and processes starting after sampling begins. It records per-process PID, parent PID, name, and RSS. Existing raw timings and memory values remain unchanged.
timing_results: The original time and token measurements are unaffected by this reporting correction. The follow-up is a memory-only measurement and is not a new speed comparison.
follow_up_scope: One CPU-only 128-token raw generation on the first confirmation prompt, without a resident PyTorch model. The report verifies model digest and zero VRAM and includes the rediscovered process tree. Sampled RSS can miss peaks and can double-count shared pages.
